problem_text:
A regional sales manager must conduct in-person client visits across 7 key branch offices.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office Alpha to Office Beta: 89.9 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Gamma: 120.1 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Delta: 72.2 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Epsilon: 87.3 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Zeta: 56.0 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Eta: 78.2 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Gamma: 162.9 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Delta: 45.9 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Epsilon: 96.0 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Zeta: 113.2 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Eta: 145.1 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Delta: 117.4 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Epsilon: 70.0 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Zeta: 173.8 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Eta: 186.9 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Epsilon: 50.2 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Zeta: 116.3 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Eta: 145.2 minutes
* Office Epsilon to Office Zeta: 142.1 minutes
* Office Epsilon to Office Eta: 165.4 minutes
* Office Zeta to Office Eta: 32.0 minutes

The objective is to determine the optimal itinerary that minimizes total transit duration, requiring a single visit to each branch before concluding the circuit back at the initial office.
